description: This file is a shell script (.sh) used for testing the rename detection feature of a diff engine, particularly for git. It sets up various scenarios with file renames and modifications, and verifies the outputs of diff commands with different configurations.

methods.description: Compares the generated diff output with the expected output.

methods.description: Writes multiple lines to a file for testing purposes.
